An '''iron helmet''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], crafted from five [[iron ingot]]s.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 2 armor and has 350 durability (vanilla: 165). Iron armor has 350 durability per piece and the vanilla armor values, 15 points for the full set. It is the base for [[Steel equipment|steel armor]].

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It melts down into one iron ingot in a [[blast furnace]], and take [[steel alloy]] at a [[smithing table]].
